name: Devang Ray
tagline: Full-stack software developer specializing in scalable REST APIs, cloud infrastructure, and secure IAM systems across startup and enterprise environments.

bullets: I led end-to-end development of a cloud-native web application and an authentication overhaul for an enterprise portal supporting 10,000+ users, while building an automated CI/CD pipeline for high-availability containerized services and driving AI-assisted development adoption across a 50-developer tribe.

I designed and deployed a full-stack Managing General Agents portal serving 1200+ users, built 20+ AWS Lambda microservices for authentication and payment processing, optimized a critical MySQL query to cut execution time from 15 minutes to 30 seconds, and automated migration of secrets management to eliminate hardcoded credentials.
I modernized a 13-year-old legacy knowledge portal into a responsive web application and implemented a keyword search feature that reduced average user search times from 10 minutes to 1.5 minutes.
I built data analysis and visualization tools to monitor the company's central messaging flow, proactively identifying system errors and reducing propagated failures by 2.6%.
I refactored 25% of backend API endpoints to enforce input validation and parameterized queries, reducing SQL injection exposure across 20,000 schools' confidential data.

education.degree: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, Summa Cum Laude (GPA: 3.91)
education.institution: University of Virginia School of Engineering & Applied Science
